Tokenizern delar texten i bitar ur en fa: The tokenizer splits the text into pieces from a fixed vocabulary and gives each piece an id. First a special token is added that marks the start.
Varje id slår upp en rad i embedding-tab: Each id looks up a row in the embedding table. Now every token is a vector of 4096 numbers. This is the starting value in the residual stream.
Varje block låter positionerna läsa från: Each block lets the positions read from each other (attention) and then processes each position on its own (MLP). The results are added to the stream. After 32 blocks, the last row carries everything needed to guess the next token.
x [5, 4096] samma shape, nytt innehåll: x [5, 4096]   same shape, new content. The last row is used.
Sista radens vektor multipliceras med LM: The vector of the last row is multiplied by the LM head. The result is one number per token in the vocabulary: the higher, the more likely the continuation.
logits [128256] de fem högsta visas: logits [128256]   the five highest are shown
Softmax gör om logits till sannolikheter: Softmax turns the logits into probabilities, and one token is drawn. Here it came out as “ mattan”.
ett id: token för ” mattan”: one id: the token for “ mattan”
Den nya token läggs till och allt körs i: The new token is appended and everything runs again. But only the new position has to be computed: the keys and values for the first five stay in the KV cache. That is how the response grows, one token per round.
1 ny position räknas, 5 läses ur KV-cach: 1 new position is computed, 5 are read from the KV cache

Med {{n}} ReLU-neuroner får kurvan {{n}}: With {{n}} ReLU neurons the curve gets {{n}} straight pieces. Mean error: {{err}}. More neurons give more kinks and a better fit.
Utan aktiveringsfunktion blir summan av: Without an activation function the sum of all neurons becomes a single straight line, whether it is {{n}} or a million. Mean error: {{err}}.

Skalning under 1 krymper skillnaderna: f: Scaling below 1 shrinks the differences: the distribution gets flatter (like high temperature).
Dense: all weights are used for “{{tok}}”. Switch token: the green weights stay completely still, only the orange activations change.

Varje token har en key och en value, fra: Every token has a key and a value, computed from its vector with Wk and Wv. The token being updated, “den”, also has a query: q = {{q}}. The query describes what “den” is looking for.
Query jämförs med varje key. För ”Katten: The query is compared with every key. For “Katten”: 1.5·2 + 0.5·0 = 3.0. The highest score goes to the key that points most in the same direction as q.
Poängen delas med √2 ≈ 1,41 (i Llama √12: The scores are divided by √2 ≈ 1.41 (in Llama √128 ≈ 11.3). Without that, dot products in many dimensions would get so large that softmax puts all the weight on a single token.
exp av varje poäng, delat med summan. Nu: exp of each score, divided by the sum. Now the scores are weights that add up to 1: “den” will fetch {{p}}% from “Katten”.
